selected_evidence.requirement: Repair links according to links.tsv and keep them as relative symlinks
selected_evidence.summary: Manifest targets were identified, both symlinks were updated to matching relative paths, and each resolved successfully.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve regular files and support relocation
selected_evidence.summary: Before/after SHA-256 hashes match. A copied bundle retained both symlinks and returned the expected report contents.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were identical before and after the work and reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID fd210619-60fe-4387-869a-76f83390b712; reboot was acknowledged, the node became unavailable, then returned with boot ID 98817ace-941c-4b9f-8eb2-645d0764d998. Links, report contents, hashes, and relocation behavior recovered successfully.

commands.command:
set -eu
bundle=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation/bundle
ln -sfn releases/two "$bundle/current"
ln -sfn releases/two/report.txt "$bundle/latest-report"
printf 'UPDATED_LINKS\n'
find "$bundle" -maxdepth 1 -type l -printf '%f\t%l\n' | sort

set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
bundle=$base/bundle
printf 'LINK_VALIDATION_IN_PLACE\n'
while IFS=' ' read -r link target extra; do
  [ "$link" = link ] && continue
  [ -z "${extra:-}" ] || { printf 'unexpected manifest fields for %s\n' "$link"; exit 1; }
  actual=$(readlink "$bundle/$link")
  [ "$actual" = "$target" ]
  case "$actual" in /*) printf 'absolute target remains: %s\n' "$link"; exit 1;; esac
  [ -e "$bundle/$link" ]
  printf '%s -> %s [relative,resolves]\n' "$link" "$actual"
done < "$base/links.tsv"
printf 'DIRECT_ACCESS_IN_PLACE\n'
printf 'current/report.txt='; cat "$bundle/current/report.txt"
printf 'latest-report='; cat "$bundle/latest-report"
printf 'FILE_HASHES_AFTER\n'
find "$bundle" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort
reloc=$(mktemp -d /tmp/report-bundle-relocated.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$reloc"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cp -a "$bundle" "$reloc/bundle-copy"
printf 'RELOCATED_COPY=%s\n' "$reloc/bundle-copy"
printf 'RELOCATED_LINKS\n'
find "$reloc/bundle-copy" -maxdepth 1 -type l -printf '%f\t%l\n' | sort
printf 'DIRECT_ACCESS_RELOCATED\n'
printf 'current/report.txt='; cat "$reloc/bundle-copy/current/report.txt"
printf 'latest-report='; cat "$reloc/bundle-copy/latest-report"
printf 'RELOCATED_FILE_HASHES\n'
find "$reloc/bundle-copy" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sed "s#$reloc/bundle-copy#COPY#" | sort
